During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] captured a '''transport''' from [[Support Services/Legends|Alliance Support Services]] that was en route to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Flitter (planet)|Flitter]]. The [[Transport/Legends|transport's]] [[Unidentified Alliance Support Services pilot|pilot]] talked under Imperial interrogation, revealing Flitter's location to the Empire.
